WITH group_averages AS (
    SELECT
        o.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(o.amount) AS average_amount
    FROM `order` AS o
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = o.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE o.amount >= 2802
    GROUP BY o.account_id, d.A3
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(average_amount) AS average_of_group_averages
    FROM group_averages
)
SELECT
    g.account_id,
    g.region,
    g.average_amount,
    g.average_amount - oa.average_of_group_averages AS difference
FROM group_averages AS g
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE g.average_amount > oa.average_of_group_averages
ORDER BY difference DESC
LIMIT 10;
